name: Keap
description: Keap is a CRM and marketing automation platform for small businesses that combines contact management, sales pipelines, and automated follow-up with invoicing and a dedicated business phone line.
best_for: Small business owners, service providers, coaches, agencies, and ecommerce businesses — Keap has served 200,000+ small businesses for over 20 years.
features: CRM and contact management with segmentation
Marketing automation for lead nurturing and follow-up campaigns
Dedicated business phone line for calls and texts

alternatives.name: HubSpot
alternatives.description: An all-in-one CRM platform with marketing, sales, and service hubs.
alternatives.best_for: Growing businesses wanting an integrated marketing-to-sales CRM suite.

alternatives.name: Zoho CRM
alternatives.description: An AI-powered CRM with omnichannel engagement and deep workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of any size wanting an affordable, feature-rich CRM.

alternatives.name: Nutshell
alternatives.description: An AI-powered sales CRM combining pipeline management with built-in email marketing.
alternatives.best_for: Small teams wanting a comprehensive CRM without complex setup.

tiers.name: Keap
tiers.notes: Starting price; annual billing is $2,988/year. Includes the full software platform and starts with 2 user licenses.

cons: Keap requires implementation services in addition to the software subscription, so the advertised $299/month starting price is not the complete onboarding cost.
The base subscription starts with 2 user licenses; additional users cost $39/month each, and contact-based pricing can increase as the database grows.
